svg.aria-label: $ ls ~/projects. finale: One-knob mastering plugin (VST3) for music producers: C++ audio engine, loudness and tonal assistants, Catch2 tests and CI. Built Claude-first with a friend. (c++ · juce · ci). coastdown-analysis: Streamlit app that automates vehicle coastdown tests (NBR 10312). ~80% less analysis time. Code private. (published at SIMEA 2026). f1-laptime-prediction: End-to-end ML on real F1 telemetry: FastF1, leave-one-race-out validation, XGBoost + SHAP. (python · ml). felipeeckert.github.io: React + Vite site with scroll-driven canvas motion. (web).
